name: @serve-tools/signal-shared-db
description: Typed, promise-based IndexedDB access with signal-backed reactive queries
author: Jonathan Neal <jonathantneal@hotmail.com> (https://jonneal.dev)

scripts.benchmark: npm run build:dependencies && vitest run --config vitest.benchmark.config.ts
scripts.build:dependencies: npm run build:dependencies --workspace @serve-tools/client-shared-db && npm run build --workspace @serve-tools/client-shared-db --workspace @serve-tools/signal --workspace @serve-tools/signal-effect
scripts.test: npm run build:dependencies && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:dependencies && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json
